The speaker lists Amazon as one of the best companies ever created that can bear the burden of infrastructure buildout.
The speaker lists Microsoft as one of the best companies ever created that can bear the burden of infrastructure buildout.
The speaker mentions Netflix in the context of the top ten US-based technology companies, but does not express a specific view on the company itself.
The speaker states that startups need all three ingredients (UI, data, business model) to win against incumbents like Salesforce, and notes no startup has yet dethroned it.
The speaker mentions RH in the context of the top ten US-based technology companies, but does not express a specific view on the company itself.
